Thank you for opening a Pull Request! Before submitting your PR, there are a few things you can do to make sure it goes smoothly:

- [ ] Ensure the tests and linter pass (`mask test unit` and `mask lint`)
- [ ] Appropriate docs were updated (if necessary)
- [ ] Check [Bencher continuous benchmarking results](https://bencher.dev/perf/polars-bigquery-client) for any performance regressions
